What tutors do on MDT.

edit_note

Build a path

Plan short lessons in a clear order, from first steps to a finished project.

videocam

Record and write

Upload video lessons, readings and downloads. We'll help with structure and editing.

quiz

Set checks and projects

Create quizzes, assignments and the final project for each path.

rate_review

Give feedback

Review projects and leave feedback that's honest, kind and useful.

How it works.

  1. Apply

    Tell us what you know and why you want to teach it.

  2. Have a chat

    A short call to talk about your subject and how you teach.

  3. Safety check

    Everyone who works with teens goes through our safeguarding check.

  4. Plan your path

    We help you shape lessons, checks and a final project.

  5. Go live

    Publish, welcome learners and see what they make.
